name.description: The package name without the @giveaway/ scope, for example "referrals-model".
name.x-prompt: What is the package name, without the @giveaway/ scope?

directory.description: The folder of packages/ that holds the package, for example "participants" or "integrations/x". Its first segment is the scope tag.
directory.x-prompt: Which folder of packages/ holds the package?

module.description: The name of the first module in src/. Defaults to the package name.

skipFormat.description: Do not run Prettier on the new files.
